name: world_watch
description: Watch the world through public feeds: live flights (civilian and military) over any area, vessel positions, satellite catalogues and ground-pass predictions, earthquakes, wildfires, rocket launches, cyclone tracks, forecast wind and rain radar, air quality, public cameras, internet radio stations, transit and bikeshare, ALPR camera locations, street-level imagery, submarine cables, datacenters and dams, and traffic flow. Keyless operations work without any API key; operations that need a key name the key and report unavailability instead of returning nothing. Reports when a feed is stale, rate-limited or on a fallback, and never fabricates a position.

operation.description: One of: flights | military_flights | vessels | satellites | space_passes | earthquakes | fires | cyclones | launches | wind | radar | air_quality | cameras | radio | transit | bikeshare | alpr | street_level | infrastructure | traffic | gnss_integrity | sources. Defaults to flights.

area.description: Free-text place name (e.g. 'Mumbai', 'Bay Area', 'my area' or 'here' for the device location). Used to geocode and to build a bounding box.

bbox.description: Explicit bounding box as 'lat_min,lat_max,lon_min,lon_max' in decimal degrees. Overrides the area and is never inferred.

lat.description: Observer latitude in decimal degrees (used by space_passes and point-based operations).

radius_km.description: Bounding-box radius in kilometres when no bbox is given. Defaults to 130 km, which is about 1.2 degrees.

norad_id.description: NORAD catalogue id for satellite operations. Defaults to 25544 (ISS).

hours.description: Prediction horizon in hours for satellite passes. Defaults to 48.

min_elevation.description: Minimum elevation in degrees for a pass to count. Defaults to 10.

category.description: Category filter for catalogue operations, e.g. a launch provider, a transit operator, a channel country, or an infrastructure type (datacenter, dam, cable).

limit.description: Maximum items to return. Defaults to 20.

author: Stella
notes: Data sources: OpenSky Network, adsb.lol, AISStream, CelesTrak, USGS, NASA FIRMS, WFIGS/NIFC, NOAA NHC/CPHC, NOAA GFS/ECMWF, NOAA nowCOAST, ECCC GeoMet, CelesTrak launch library, GTFS-RT operators, GBFS, OSRM (FOSSGIS), Radio Browser, Mapillary, KartaView, Panoramax, OpenStreetMap. Each operation names its source and its auth tier in the result.
